evidence: Carries the Wallet label, modifies wallet rebroadcasting behavior in src/wallet/wallet.cpp, and refactors test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py.
rationale: Stops periodic wallet rebroadcast of transactions already in the mempool to eliminate an IP-linking privacy leak. As noted in the description, unconditional rebroadcasts signal 'a special interest in the transaction, leaking the user's IP and wallet ownership.'
